name: <link="ADVANCEDAPOTHECARY">Nuclear Apothecary</link>
description: Some medications help prevent diseases, while others aim to alleviate existing illness.
effect:
Produces <link="MEDICINE">Medicine</link> to cure most basic <link="DISEASE">Diseases</link>.

Duplicants must possess the Medicine Compounding <link="ROLES">Skill</link> to fabricate medicines.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: <link="ADVANCEDCRAFTINGTABLE">Soldering Station</link>
description: Soldering stations allow Duplicants to build helpful Flydo retriever bots.
effect:
Produces advanced electronics and bionic <link="BIONICUPGRADE">Boosters</link>.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: <link="ADVANCEDDOCTORSTATION">Disease Clinic</link>
description: Disease clinics require power, but treat more serious illnesses than sick bays alone.
effect:
Allows Duplicants to administer powerful treatments to sick Duplicants.

Duplicants must possess the Advanced Medical Care <link="ROLES">Skill</link> to treat peers.

name: <link="ADVANCEDRESEARCHCENTER">Super Computer</link>
description: Super computers unlock higher technology tiers than research stations alone.
effect:
Conducts <link="RESEARCH">Advanced Research</link> to unlock new technologies.

Consumes <link="WATER">Water</link>.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the <link="RESEARCHING1">Advanced Research</link> skill.

name: <link="AIRBORNECRITTERCONDO">Airborne Critter Condo</link>
description: Triggers natural nesting instincts and improves critters' moods.
effect: A hanging respite area for adult <link="PUFT">Pufts</link>, <link="MOOSPECIES">Moos</link> and <link="LIGHTBUG">Shine Bugs</link>.

name: <link="AIRCONDITIONER">Thermo Regulator</link>
description: A thermo regulator doesn't remove heat, but relocates it to a new area.
effect: Cools the <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> piped through it, but outputs <link="HEAT">Heat</link> in its immediate vicinity.

name: <link="AIRFILTER">Deodorizer</link>
description: Oh! Citrus scented!
effect: Uses <link="SAND">Sand</link> to filter <link="CONTAMINATEDOXYGEN">Polluted Oxygen</link> from the air, reducing <link="DISEASE">Disease</link> spread.

name: <link="AIRBORNECREATURELURE">Airborne Critter Lure</link>
description: Lures can relocate Pufts or Shine Bugs to specific locations in my colony.
effect:
Attracts one type of airborne critter at a time.

Must be baited with <link="SLIMEMOLD">Slime</link> or <link="PHOSPHORITE">Phosphorite</link>.

name: <link="ALGAEDISTILLERY">Algae Distiller</link>
description: Algae distillers convert disease-causing slime into algae for oxygen production.
effect: Refines <link="SLIMEMOLD">Slime</link> into <link="ALGAE">Algae</link>.

name: <link="ALGAEHABITAT">Algae Terrarium</link>
description: Algae colony, Duplicant colony... we're more alike than we are different.
effect:
Consumes <link="ALGAE">Algae</link> to produce <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link> and remove some <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link>.

Gains a 10% efficiency boost in direct <link="LIGHT">Light</link>.

name: <link="APOTHECARY">Apothecary</link>
description: Some medications help prevent diseases, while others aim to alleviate existing illness.
effect:
Produces <link="MEDICINE">Medicine</link> to cure most basic <link="DISEASE">Diseases</link>.

Duplicants must possess the Medicine Compounding <link="ROLES">Skill</link> to fabricate medicines.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: <link="ARCADEMACHINE">Arcade Cabinet</link>
description:
Komet Kablam-O!
For up to two players.
effect:
Allows Duplicants to play video games on their breaks.

Increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

name: <link="ARTIFACTANALYSISSTATION">Artifact Analysis Station</link>
description: Discover the mysteries of the past.
effect: Analyses and extracts <link="UNOBTANIUM">Neutronium</link> from artifacts of interest.

name: <link="ARTIFACTCARGOBAY">Artifact Transport Module</link>
description: Holds artifacts found in space.
effect:
Allows Duplicants to store any artifacts they uncover during space missions.

Artifacts become available to the colony upon the rocket's return. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

name: <link="ASTRONAUTTRAININGCENTER">Space Cadet Centrifuge</link>
description: Duplicants must complete astronaut training in order to pilot space rockets.
effect:
Trains Duplicants to become <link="ROCKETPILOTING1">Astronaut</link>.

Duplicants must possess the <link="ROCKETPILOTING1">Astronaut</link> trait to receive training.

name: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.ATOMICGARDEN.NAME
description: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.ATOMICGARDEN.DESC
effect: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.ATOMICGARDEN.EFFECT

name: <link="AUTOMINER">Robo-Miner</link>
description: A robo-miner's range can be viewed at any time by selecting the building.
effect: Automatically digs out all materials in a set range.

name: <link="BATTERY">Battery</link>
description: Batteries allow power from generators to be stored for later.
effect:
Stores <link="POWER">Power</link> from generators, then provides that power to buildings.

Loses charge over time.

name: <link="BATTERYMEDIUM">Jumbo Battery</link>
description: Larger batteries hold more power and keep systems running longer before recharging.
effect:
Stores <link="POWER">Power</link> from generators, then provides that power to buildings.

Slightly loses charge over time.

name: <link="BATTERYMODULE">Battery Module</link>
description: Charging a battery module before takeoff makes it easier to power buildings during flight.
effect:
Stores the excess <link="POWER">Power</link> generated by a Rocket Engine or <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

Provides stored power to <link="ROCKETINTERIORPOWERPLUG">Interior Rocket Outlets</link>.

Loses charge over time. 

Must be built via Rocket Platform.

name: <link="BATTERYSMART">Smart Battery</link>
description: Smart batteries send a Green Signal when they require charging.
effect: Stores Power from generators, then provides that power to buildings. Sends a Green Signal or Red Signal based on the configuration of the Logic Activation Parameters. Very slightly loses charge over time.

name: <link="BEACHCHAIR">Beach Chair</link>
description: Soak up some relaxing sun rays.
effect:
Duplicants can relax by lounging in <link="LIGHT">Sunlight</link>.

Increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

name: <link="BED">Cot</link>
description: Duplicants without a bed will develop sore backs from sleeping on the floor.
effect:
Gives one Duplicant a place to sleep.

Duplicants will automatically return to their cots to sleep at night.

name: <link="BIODIESELENGINECLUSTER">Biodiesel Engine</link>
description: More powerful rocket engines can propel heavier burdens.
effect:
Burns <link="REFINEDLIPID">Biodiesel</link> to propel rockets for mid-range space exploration.

Biodiesel Engines have generous height restrictions, ideal for hauling many modules.

Engine must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>, and requires an oxidizer tank.

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

name: <link="BOTTLEEMPTIERCONDUITGAS">Canister Drainer</link>
description: A canister drainer's Element Filter can designate areas for specific gas storage.
effect: Drains <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> canisters into <link="GASCONDUIT">Gas Pipes</link>.

name: <link="BOTTLEEMPTIERCONDUITLIQUID">Bottle Drainer</link>
description: A bottle drainer's Element Filter can be used to designate areas for specific liquid storage.
effect: Drains bottled <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> into <link="LIQUIDCONDUIT">Liquid Pipes</link>.

name: <link="BOTTLEEMPTIER">Bottle Emptier</link>
description: A bottle emptier's Element Filter can be used to designate areas for specific liquid storage.
effect: Empties bottled <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> back into the world.

name: <link="BOTTLEEMPTIERGAS">Canister Emptier</link>
description: A canister emptier's Element Filter can designate areas for specific gas storage.
effect: Empties <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> canisters back into the world.

name: <link="BUNKERDOOR">Bunker Door</link>
description: A massive, slow-moving door which is nearly indestructible.
effect:
Blocks <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> and <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> flow, maintaining pressure between areas.

Can withstand extremely high pressures and impacts.

name: <link="BUNKERTILE">Bunker Tile</link>
description: Bunker tile can build strong shelters in otherwise dangerous environments.
effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Can withstand extreme pressures and impacts.

name: <link="CO2ENGINE">Carbon Dioxide Engine</link>
description: Rockets can be used to send Duplicants into space and retrieve rare resources.
effect:
Uses pressurized <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link> to propel rockets for short range space exploration.

Carbon Dioxide Engines are relatively fast engine for their size but with limited height restrictions.

Engine must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

name: <link="CO2SCRUBBER">Carbon Skimmer</link>
description: Skimmers remove large amounts of carbon dioxide, but produce no breathable air.
effect: Uses <link="WATER">Water</link> to filter <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link> from the air.

name: <link="CAMPFIRE">Wood Heater</link>
description: Wood heaters dry out soggy feet and help Duplicants forget how cold they are.
effect: Consumes <link="WOOD">Wood</link> in order to <link="HEAT">Heat</link> chilly surroundings.

name: <link="CANVAS">Blank Canvas</link>
description: Once built, a Duplicant can paint a blank canvas to produce a decorative painting.
effect:
Increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be painted by a Duplicant.

name: <link="CANVASTALL">Portrait Canvas</link>
description: Once built, a Duplicant can paint a blank canvas to produce a decorative painting.
effect:
Moderately increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be painted by a Duplicant.

name: <link="CANVASWIDE">Landscape Canvas</link>
description: Once built, a Duplicant can paint a blank canvas to produce a decorative painting.
effect:
Moderately increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be painted by a Duplicant.

name: <link="CARPETTILE">Carpeted Tile</link>
description: Soft on little Duplicant toesies.
effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

name: <link="CEILINGFOSSILSCULPTURE">Hanging Fossil Block</link>
description: Duplicants who have learned art skills can produce more decorative ceiling sculptures.
effect:
Majorly increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

name: <link="CEILINGLIGHT">Ceiling Light</link>
description: Light reduces Duplicant stress and is required to grow certain plants.
effect:
Provides <link="LIGHT">Light</link> when <link="POWER">Powered</link>.

Increases Duplicant workspeed within light radius.

name: <link="CHECKPOINT">Duplicant Checkpoint</link>
description: Checkpoints can be connected to automated sensors to determine when it's safe to enter.
effect: Allows Duplicants to pass when receiving a Green Signal. Prevents Duplicants from passing when receiving a Red Signal.

name: <link="CHEMICALREFINERY">Emulsifier</link>
description: It's like a blender, but better.
effect:
Combines <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> and other inputs into fluid compounds.

Duplicants will not fabricate emulsions unless recipes are queued.

name: <link="CHLORINATOR">Bleach Stone Hopper</link>
description: Bleach stone is useful for sanitation and geotuning.
effect: Uses <link="SALT">Salt</link> and <link="GOLD">Gold</link> to produce <link="BLEACHSTONE">Bleach Stone</link>.

name: <link="CLOTHINGALTERATIONSTATION">Clothing Refashionator</link>
description: Allows skilled Duplicants to add extra personal pizzazz to their wardrobe.
effect:
Upgrades <link="FUNKYVEST">Snazzy Suits</link> into <link="CUSTOMCLOTHING">Primo Garb</link>.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: <link="CLOTHINGFABRICATOR">Textile Loom</link>
description: A textile loom can be used to spin Reed Fiber into wearable Duplicant clothing.
effect:
Tailors Duplicant <link="EQUIPMENT">Clothing</link> items.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: <link="CLUSTERTELESCOPE">Telescope</link>
description: Telescopes are necessary for studying space, allowing rocket travel to other worlds.
effect:
Reveals visitable Planetoids in space, producing <link="DATABANK">Data Banks</link> in the process.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the <link="ASTRONOMY">Astronomy</link> skill.

Building must be exposed to space to function.

name: <link="CLUSTERTELESCOPEENCLOSED">Enclosed Telescope</link>
description: It's easier to focus on work when shielded from the vacuum of space.
effect:
Reveals visitable Planetoids in space and produces <link="DATABANK">Data Banks</link>... in comfort!

Assigned Duplicants must possess the <link="ASTRONOMY">Astronomy</link> skill.

Excellent sunburn protection (100%), partial <link="RADIATION">Radiation</link> protection (50%) .

Building must be exposed to space to function.

name: <link="COMETDETECTOR">Space Scanner</link>
description: Networks of many scanners will scan more efficiently than one on its own.
effect: Sends a Green Signal to its automation circuit when it detects incoming objects from space. Can be configured to detect incoming meteor showers or returning space rockets.

name: <link="COMPOST">Compost</link>
description: Composts safely deal with biological waste, producing fresh dirt.
effect: Reduces <link="TOXICSAND">Polluted Dirt</link>, rotting <link="FOOD">Foods</link>, and discarded organics down into <link="DIRT">Dirt</link>.

name: <link="GASCONDUITDISEASESENSOR">Gas Pipe Germ Sensor</link>
description: Germ sensors can help control automation behavior in the presence of germs.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on the internal Germ count of the pipe.

name: <link="LIQUIDCONDUITDISEASESENSOR">Liquid Pipe Germ Sensor</link>
description: Germ sensors can help control automation behavior in the presence of germs.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on the internal Germ count of the pipe.

name: <link="GASCONDUITELEMENTSENSOR">Gas Pipe Element Sensor</link>
description: Element sensors can be used to detect the presence of a specific gas in a pipe.
effect: Sends a Green Signal when the selected Gas is detected within a pipe.

name: <link="LIQUIDCONDUITELEMENTSENSOR">Liquid Pipe Element Sensor</link>
description: Element sensors can be used to detect the presence of a specific liquid in a pipe.
effect: Sends a Green Signal when the selected Liquid is detected within a pipe.

name: <link="GASCONDUITTEMPERATURESENSOR">Gas Pipe Thermo Sensor</link>
description: Thermo sensors disable buildings when their pipe contents reach a certain temperature.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when pipe contents enter the chosen Temperature range.

name: <link="LIQUIDCONDUITTEMPERATURESENSOR">Liquid Pipe Thermo Sensor</link>
description: Thermo sensors disable buildings when their pipe contents reach a certain temperature.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when pipe contents enter the chosen Temperature range.

name: <link="CONTACTCONDUCTIVEPIPEBRIDGE">Conduction Panel</link>
description: It can transfer heat effectively even if no liquid is passing through.
effect:
Carries <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>, allowing extreme <link="HEAT">Temperature</link> exchange with overlapping buildings.

Can function in a vacuum.

Can be run through wall and floor tiles.

name: <link="COOKINGSTATION">Electric Grill</link>
description: Proper cooking eliminates foodborne disease and produces tasty, stress-relieving meals.
effect:
Cooks a wide variety of improved <link="FOOD">Foods</link>.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: <link="CORNERMOULDING">Corner Trim</link>
description: Corner trim is a purely decorative addition for ceiling corners.
effect:
Used to decorate the ceiling corners of rooms.

Increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

name: <link="CRAFTINGTABLE">Crafting Station</link>
description: Crafting stations allow Duplicants to make oxygen masks to wear in low breathability areas.
effect:
Produces items and equipment for Duplicant use.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: <link="CREATUREDELIVERYPOINT">Critter Drop-Off</link>
description: Duplicants automatically bring captured critters to these relocation points for release.
effect:
Releases trapped <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> back into the world.

Can be used multiple times.

name: <link="CREATUREFEEDER">Critter Feeder</link>
description: Critters tend to stay close to their food source and wander less when given a feeder.
effect: Automatically dispenses food for hungry <link="CREATURES">Critters</link>.

name: <link="CREATURETRAP">Critter Trap</link>
description: Critter traps cannot catch swimming or flying critters.
effect:
Captures a living <link="CREATURES">Critter</link> for transport.

Single use.

name: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.CREWCAPSULE.NAME
description: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.CREWCAPSULE.DESC
effect: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.CREWCAPSULE.EFFECT

name: <link="CRITTERCONDO">Critter Condo</link>
description: It's nice to have nice things.
effect: Provides a comfortable lounge area that boosts domesticated <link="CREATURES">Critters'</link> happiness.

name: <link="CRITTERDROPOFF">Critter Drop-Off</link>
description: Duplicants automatically bring captured critters to these relocation points for release.
effect:
Releases trapped <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> back into the world.

Monitoring and drop-off are limited to the specified species.

name: <link="CRITTERPICKUP">Critter Pick-Up</link>
description: Duplicants will automatically wrangle excess critters.
effect:
Ensures the prompt relocation of <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> that exceed the maximum amount set.

Monitoring and pick-up are limited to the specified species.

name: <link="CROWNMOULDING">Ceiling Trim</link>
description: Ceiling trim is a purely decorative addition to one's overhead area.
effect:
Used to decorate the ceilings of rooms.

Increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

name: <link="DLC1COSMICRESEARCHCENTER">Virtual Planetarium</link>
description: Planetariums allow the simulated exploration of locations recorded in <link="ORBITALRESEARCHDATABANK">Data Banks</link>.
effect:
Conducts <link="RESEARCH">Data Analysis Research</link> to unlock new technologies.

Consumes <link="ORBITALRESEARCHDATABANK">Data Banks</link> generated by exploration.

name: <link="DATAMINER">Data Miner</link>
description: Data banks can also be used to program robo-pilot rocket modules.
effect:
Mass-produces <link="DATABANK">Data Banks</link> that can be processed into <link="RESEARCHDLC1">Data Analysis Research</link> points.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: <link="DECONTAMINATIONSHOWER">Decontamination Shower</link>
description: Don't forget to decontaminate behind your ears.
effect:
Uses <link="WATER">Water</link> to remove <link="DISEASE">Germs</link> and <link="RADIATION">Radiation</link>.

Decontaminates both Duplicants and their <link="EQUIPMENT">Clothing</link>.

name: <link="DEEPFRYER">Deep Fryer</link>
description: Everything tastes better when it's deep-fried.
effect:
Uses <link="TALLOW">Tallow</link> to cook a wide variety of improved <link="FOOD">Foods</link>.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Dev Generator
description: Runs on coffee.
effect: Generates testing power for late nights.

name: Dev Radbolt Generator
description: Radbolts are necessary for producing Materials Science research.
effect: Generates Radbolts.

name: Dev Heater
description: Did someone touch the thermostat?
effect: Generates on-demand heat for testing toastiness.

name: Dev Life Support
description: Keeps Duplicants cozy and breathing.
effect: Generates warm, oxygen-rich air.

name: Dev Light Source
description: Brightens up a dev's darkest hours.
effect: Generates dimmable light on demand.

name: Dev Pump Gas
description: Piping a pump's output to a building's intake will send gas to that building.
effect:
Draws in <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> and runs it through <link="GASPIPING">Pipes</link>.

Must be immersed in <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link>.

name: Dev Pump Liquid
description: Piping a pump's output to a building's intake will send liquid to that building.
effect:
Draws in <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> and runs it through <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Pipes</link>.

Must be submerged in <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>.

name: Dev Pump Solid
description: Piping a pump's output to a building's intake will send solids to that building.
effect: Generates chosen <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> and runs it through <link="SOLIDCONDUIT">Conveyor Rail</link>

name: Dev Radiation Emitter
description: That's some strong coffee.
effect: Generates on-demand radiation to keep things clear. Nu-clear.

name: <link="DIAMONDPRESS">Diamond Press</link>
description: Crushes refined carbon into diamond.
effect:
Uses <link="POWER">Power</link> and <link="RADIATION">Radbolts</link> to crush <link="REFINEDCARBON">Refined Carbon</link> into <link="DIAMOND">Diamond</link>.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued and <link="REFINEDCARBON">Refined Carbon</link> has been discovered.

name: <link="DININGTABLE">Mess Table</link>
description: Duplicants prefer to dine at a table, rather than eat off the floor.
effect:
Gives one Duplicant a place to eat.

Duplicants will automatically eat at their assigned table when hungry.

name: <link="DOCTORSTATION">Sick Bay</link>
description: Sick bays can be placed in hospital rooms to decrease the likelihood of disease spreading.
effect:
Allows Duplicants to administer basic treatments to sick Duplicants.

Duplicants must possess the Bedside Manner <link="ROLES">Skill</link> to treat peers.

name: <link="DOOR">Pneumatic Door</link>
description: Door controls can be used to prevent Duplicants from entering restricted areas.
effect:
Encloses areas without blocking <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> or <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> flow.

Wild <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> cannot pass through doors.

name: <link="EGGCRACKER">Egg Cracker</link>
description: Raw eggs are an ingredient in certain high quality food recipes.
effect:
Converts viable <link="CREATURES">Critter</link> eggs into cooking ingredients.

Cracked Eggs cannot hatch.

Duplicants will not crack eggs unless tasks are queued.

name: <link="EGGINCUBATOR">Incubator</link>
description: Incubators can maintain the ideal internal conditions for several species of critter egg.
effect:
Incubates <link="CREATURES">Critter</link> eggs until ready to hatch.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the <link="RANCHING1">Critter Ranching</link> skill.

name: <link="ELECTROBANKCHARGER">Power Bank Charger</link>
description: Bionic Duplicants rely on a steady supply of power to function.
effect: Converts empty <link="ELECTROBANK">Eco Power Banks</link> into fully charged units ready for reuse.

name: <link="ELECTROLYZER">Electrolyzer</link>
description: Water goes in one end, life sustaining oxygen comes out the other.
effect:
Converts <link="WATER">Water</link> into <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link> and <link="HYDROGEN">Hydrogen Gas</link>.

Becomes idle when the area reaches maximum pressure capacity.

name: <link="ESPRESSOMACHINE">Espresso Machine</link>
description: A shot of espresso helps Duplicants relax after a long day.
effect:
Provides refreshment for Duplicants on their breaks.

Increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

name: <link="ETHANOLDISTILLERY">Ethanol Distiller</link>
description: Ethanol distillers convert <link="WOOD">Wood</link> into burnable <link="ETHANOL">Ethanol</link> fuel.
effect: Refines <link="WOOD">Wood</link> into <link="ETHANOL">Ethanol</link>.

name: <link="EXOBASEHEADQUARTERS">Mini-Pod</link>
description: A quick and easy substitute, though it'll never live up to the original.
effect:
A portable bioprinter that produces new Duplicants or care packages containing resources.

Only one Printing Pod or Mini-Pod is permitted per Planetoid.

name: <link="EXTERIORWALL">Drywall</link>
description: Drywall can be used in conjunction with tiles to build airtight rooms on the surface.
effect:
Prevents <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> and <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> loss in space.

Builds an insulating backwall behind buildings.

name: <link="FABRICATEDWOODMAKER">Plywood Press</link>
description: Flattened plant bits are a useful wood substitute.
effect: Combines a Binder liquid and <link="PLANTFIBER">Plant Husk</link> to create <link="FABRICATEDWOOD">Plywood</link>.

name: Window
effect: A tall, thin window.

name: <link="FARMSTATION">Farm Station</link>
description: This station only has an effect on crops grown within the same room.
effect:
Produces <link="FARMSTATIONTOOLS">Micronutrient Fertilizer</link> to increase <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> growth rates.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the <link="FARMING2">Crop Tending</link> trait.

This building is a necessary component of the Greenhouse room.

name: <link="FARMTILE">Farm Tile</link>
description: Duplicants can deliver fertilizer and liquids to farm tiles, accelerating plant growth.
effect:
Grows one <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> from a <link="PLANTS">Seed</link>.

Can be used as floor tile and rotated before construction.

name: <link="FERTILIZERMAKER">Fertilizer Synthesizer</link>
description: Fertilizer synthesizers convert polluted dirt into fertilizer for domestic plants.
effect: Uses <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link> and <link="PHOSPHORITE">Phosphorite</link> to produce <link="FERTILIZER">Fertilizer</link>.

name: <link="FIREPOLE">Fire Pole</link>
description: Build these in addition to ladders for efficient upward and downward movement.
effect:
Allows rapid Duplicant descent.

Significantly slows upward climbing.

name: <link="FISHDELIVERYPOINT">Fish Release</link>
description: A fish release must be built in liquid to prevent released fish from suffocating.
effect:
Releases trapped aquatic critters back into the world.

Can be used multiple times.

name: <link="FISHFEEDER">Fish Feeder</link>
description: Build this feeder above a body of water to feed the fish within.
effect:
Automatically dispenses stored <link="CREATURES">Critter</link> food into the area below.

Dispenses continuously as food is consumed.

name: <link="FISHPICKUP">Fish Pick-Up</link>
description: Duplicants will automatically wrangle excess fish from the pool below.
effect:
Ensures the prompt capture of aquatic <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> that exceed the maximum amount set.

Monitoring and pick-up are limited to the specified species.

Must be built above a <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> pool.

name: <link="FISHTRAP">Fish Trap</link>
description: Trapped fish will automatically be bagged for transport.
effect:
Attracts and traps swimming <link="PACU">Pacu</link>.

Single use.

name: <link="FLOORLAMP">Lamp</link>
description: Any building's light emitting radius can be viewed in the light overlay.
effect:
Provides <link="LIGHT">Light</link> when <link="POWER">Powered</link>.

Increases Duplicant workspeed within light radius.

name: <link="FLOORSWITCH">Weight Plate</link>
description: Weight plates can be used to turn on amenities only when Duplicants pass by.
effect: Sends a Green Signal when an object or Duplicant is placed atop of it. Cannot be triggered by Gas or Liquids.

name: <link="FLOWERVASE">Flower Pot</link>
description: Flower pots allow decorative plants to be moved to new locations.
effect:
Houses a single <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> when sown with a <link="PLANTS">Seed</link>.

Increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link> when in use, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

name: <link="FLOWERVASEHANGING">Hanging Pot</link>
description: Hanging pots can add some Decor to a room, without blocking buildings on the floor.
effect:
Houses a single <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> when sown with a <link="PLANTS">Seed</link>.

Increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link> when in use, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be hung from a ceiling.

name: <link="FLOWERVASEHANGINGFANCY">Aero Pot</link>
description: Aero pots can be hung from the ceiling and have extremely high Decor.
effect:
Houses a single <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> when sown with a <link="PLANTS">Seed</link>.

Increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link> even when empty, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be hung from a ceiling.

name: <link="FLOWERVASEWALL">Wall Pot</link>
description: Placing a plant in a wall pot can add a spot of Decor to otherwise bare walls.
effect:
Houses a single <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> when sown with a <link="PLANTS">Seed</link>.

Increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link> when in use, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be hung from a wall.

name: <link="FLUSHTOILET">Lavatory</link>
description: Lavatories transmit fewer germs to Duplicants' skin and require no emptying.
effect:
Gives Duplicants a place to relieve themselves.

Spreads very few <link="DISEASE">Germs</link>.

name: <link="FLYINGCREATUREBAIT">Airborne Critter Bait</link>
description: The type of critter attracted by critter bait depends on the construction material.
effect:
Attracts one type of airborne critter.

Single use.

name: <link="FOODDEHYDRATOR">Dehydrator</link>
description: Some of the eliminated liquid inevitably ends up on the floor.
effect:
Uses low, even heat to eliminate moisture from eligible <link="FOOD">Foods</link> and render them shelf-stable.

Dehydrated meals must be processed at the <link="FOODREHYDRATOR">Rehydrator</link> before they can be eaten.

name: <link="FOODREHYDRATOR">Rehydrator</link>
description: Rehydrated food is nutritious and only slightly less delicious.
effect: Restores moisture to convert shelf-stable packaged meals into edible <link="FOOD">Food</link>.

name: Ancient Specimen
description: It's not from around here.
effect:
Contains a partial <link="FOSSIL">Fossil</link> left behind by a giant critter.

Studying the full skeleton could yield the information required to access a valuable new resource.

name: <link="FOSSILSCULPTURE">Fossil Block</link>
description: Duplicants who have learned art skills can produce more decorative sculptures.
effect:
Majorly increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

name: <link="GANTRY">Gantry</link>
description: A gantry can be built over rocket pieces where ladders and tile cannot.
effect: Provides scaffolding across rocket modules to allow Duplicant access.

name: <link="GASBOTTLER">Canister Filler</link>
description: Canisters allow Duplicants to manually deliver gases from place to place.
effect: Automatically stores piped <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gases</link> into canisters for manual transport.

name: <link="GASCARGOBAYCLUSTER">Large Gas Cargo Canister</link>
description: Holds more than a typical gas cargo canister.
effect:
Allows Duplicants to store most of the <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> resources found during space missions.

Stored resources become available to the colony upon the rocket's return.

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

name: <link="GASCARGOBAYSMALL">Gas Cargo Canister</link>
description: Duplicants fill cargo canisters with any resources they find during space missions.
effect:
Allows Duplicants to store some of the <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> resources found during space missions.

Stored resources become available to the colony upon the rocket's return. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

name: <link="GASCONDUITBRIDGE">Gas Bridge</link>
description: Separate pipe systems prevent mingled contents from causing building damage.
effect:
Runs one <link="GASPIPING">Gas Pipe</link> section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: <link="GASCONDUIT">Gas Pipe</link>
description: Gas pipes are used to connect the inputs and outputs of ventilated buildings.
effect:
Carries <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> between <link="GASPIPING">Outputs</link> and <link="GASPIPING">Intakes</link>.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: <link="GASCONDUITOVERFLOW">Gas Overflow Valve</link>
description: Overflow valves can be used to prioritize which buildings should receive precious resources first.
effect: Fills a secondary<link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> output only when its primary output is blocked.

name: <link="GASCONDUITPREFERENTIALFLOW">Priority Gas Flow</link>
description: Priority flows ensure important buildings are filled first when on a system with other buildings.
effect: Diverts <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> to a secondary input when its primary input overflows.

name: <link="GASCONDUITRADIANT">Radiant Gas Pipe</link>
description: Radiant pipes pumping cold gas can be run through hot areas to help cool them down.
effect:
Carries <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link>, allowing extreme <link="HEAT">Temperature</link> exchange with the surrounding environment.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: <link="GASFILTER">Gas Filter</link>
description: All gases are sent into the building's output pipe, except the gas chosen for filtering.
effect: Sieves one <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> from the air, sending it into a dedicated <link="GASPIPING">Pipe</link>.

name: <link="GASLIMITVALVE">Gas Meter Valve</link>
description: Meter Valves let an exact amount of gas pass through before shutting off.
effect: Connects to an <link="LOGIC">Automation</link> grid to automatically turn <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> flow off when the specified amount has passed through it.

name: <link="GASLOGICVALVE">Gas Shutoff</link>
description: Automated piping saves power and time by removing the need for Duplicant input.
effect: Connects to an <link="LOGIC">Automation</link> grid to automatically turn <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> flow on or off.

name: <link="GASMINIPUMP">Mini Gas Pump</link>
description: Mini pumps are useful for moving small quantities of gas with minimum power.
effect:
Draws in a small amount of <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> and runs it through <link="GASPIPING">Pipes</link>.

Must be immersed in <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link>.

name: <link="GASPERMEABLEMEMBRANE">Airflow Tile</link>
description: Building with airflow tile promotes better gas circulation within a colony.
effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Blocks <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> flow without obstructing <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link>.

name: <link="GASPUMP">Gas Pump</link>
description: Piping a pump's output to a building's intake will send gas to that building.
effect:
Draws in <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> and runs it through <link="GASPIPING">Pipes</link>.

Must be immersed in <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link>.

name: <link="GASRESERVOIR">Gas Reservoir</link>
description: Reservoirs cannot receive manually delivered resources.
effect: Stores any <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> resources piped into it.

name: <link="GASVALVE">Gas Valve</link>
description: Valves control the amount of gas that moves through pipes, preventing waste.
effect: Controls the <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> volume permitted through <link="GASPIPING">Pipes</link>.

name: <link="GASVENT">Gas Vent</link>
description: Vents are an exit point for gases from ventilation systems.
effect: Releases <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> from <link="GASPIPING">Gas Pipes</link>.

name: <link="GASVENTHIGHPRESSURE">High Pressure Gas Vent</link>
description: High pressure vents can expel gas into more highly pressurized environments.
effect: Releases <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> from <link="GASPIPING">Gas Pipes</link> into high pressure locations.

name: <link="GENERATOR">Coal Generator</link>
description: Burning coal produces more energy than manual power, but emits heat and exhaust.
effect:
Converts <link="CARBON">Coal</link> into electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.

Produces <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link>.

name: <link="GENERICFABRICATOR">Omniprinter</link>
description: Omniprinters are incapable of printing organic matter.
effect: Converts <link="RAWMINERAL">Raw Mineral</link> into unique materials and objects.

name: <link="GENETICANALYSISSTATION">Botanical Analyzer</link>
description: Would a mutated rose still smell as sweet?
effect: Identifies new <link="PLANTS">Seed</link> subspecies.

name: <link="GEOTUNER">Geotuner</link>
description: The targeted geyser receives stored amplification data when it is erupting.
effect:
Increases the <link="HEAT">Temperature</link> and output of an analyzed <link="GEYSERS">Geyser</link>.

Multiple Geotuners can be directed at a single <link="GEYSERS">Geyser</link> anywhere on an asteroid.

name: <link="GLASSCEILINGLIGHT">Glass Ceiling Light</link>
description: It's an attractive way to add overhead lighting in aquatic spaces.
effect:
Provides <link="LIGHT">Light</link> when <link="POWER">Powered</link>.

Increases Duplicant workspeed within light radius.

name: <link="GLASSEXTERIORWALL">Glass Backwall</link>
description: Glass Backwall adds a touch of elegance while sealing rooms from the vacuum of space.
effect:
Prevents <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> and <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> loss in space.

Builds a transparent backwall behind buildings.

Provides higher <link="DECOR">Decor</link> than standard drywall.

name: <link="GLASSFORGE">Glass Forge</link>
description: Glass can be used to construct window tile.
effect:
Produces <link="MOLTENGLASS">Molten Glass</link> from raw <link="SAND">Sand</link>.

Outputs <link="HEAT">High Temperature</link> <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: <link="GLASSTILE">Window Tile</link>
description: Window tiles provide a barrier against liquid and gas and are completely transparent.
effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Allows <link="LIGHT">Light</link> and <link="DECOR">Decor</link> to pass through.

name: <link="GOURMETCOOKINGSTATION">Gas Range</link>
description: Luxury meals increase Duplicants' morale and prevent them from becoming stressed.
effect:
Cooks a wide variety of quality <link="FOOD">Foods</link>.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: <link="GRAVE">Tasteful Memorial</link>
description: Burying dead Duplicants reduces health hazards and stress on the colony.
effect:
Provides a final resting place for deceased Duplicants.

Living Duplicants will automatically place an unburied corpse inside.

name: Toilet
effect:
A private toilet for senior scientists.

It was the site of many great scientific breakthroughs.

name: Pajama Cubby
effect:
A clothing storage unit.

It contains ultra-soft sleepwear.

name: <link="GRAVITASCREATUREMANIPULATOR">Critter Flux-O-Matic</link>
effect:
An experimental DNA manipulator.

Analyzes <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> to transform base morphs into random variants of their species.

name: Gravitas Door
effect: An office door to an office that no longer exists.

name: LED Light
effect: An overhead light therapy lamp designed to soothe the minds.

name: <link="ITEMPEDESTAL">Gravitas Pedestal</link>
description: Perception can be drastically changed by a bit of thoughtful presentation.
effect:
Displays a single object, doubling its <link="DECOR">Decor</link> value.

Objects with negative Decor will gain some positive Decor when displayed.

name: <link="GUNKEMPTIER">Gunk Extractor</link>
description: Bionic Duplicants are much more relaxed after a visit to the gunk extractor.
effect: Cleanses stale <link="LIQUIDGUNK">Gunk</link> build-up from Duplicants' bionic parts.

name: <link="HEPBATTERY">Radbolt Chamber</link>
description: Particles packed up and ready to go.
effect: Stores Radbolts in a high-energy state, ready for transport. Requires a Green Signal to release radbolts from storage when the Radbolt threshold is reached. Radbolts in storage will rapidly decay while this building is disabled.

name: <link="HEPBRIDGETILE">Radbolt Joint Plate</link>
description: Allows Radbolts to pass through walls.
effect: Receives <link="RADIATION">Radbolts</link> from <link="HIGHENERGYPARTICLESPAWNER">Radbolt Generators</link> and directs them through walls. All other materials and elements will be blocked from passage.

name: <link="HEPENGINE">Radbolt Engine</link>
description: Radbolt-fueled rockets support few modules, but travel exceptionally far.
effect:
Injects <link="RADIATION">Radbolts</link> into a reaction chamber to propel rockets for long-range space exploration.

Radbolt Engines are faster than <link="HYDROGENENGINE">Hydrogen Engines</link> but with a more restrictive height allowance.

Engine must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

name: <link="HABITATMODULEMEDIUM">Spacefarer Module</link>
description: Allows Duplicants to survive space travel... Hopefully.
effect:
Functions as a Command Module.

Holds up to 10 Duplicant travellers.

One Command Module may be installed per rocket. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

name: <link="HABITATMODULESMALL">Solo Spacefarer Nosecone</link>
description: One lucky Duplicant gets the best view from the whole rocket.
effect:
Functions as a Command Module and a Nosecone.

Holds one Duplicant traveller.

One Command Module may be installed per rocket.

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>. 

Must be built at the top of a rocket.

name: <link="HANDSANITIZER">Hand Sanitizer</link>
description: Hand sanitizers kill germs more effectively than wash basins.
effect:
Removes most <link="DISEASE">Germs</link> from Duplicants.

Germ-covered Duplicants use Hand Sanitizers when passing by in the selected direction.

name: <link="HEADQUARTERS">Printing Pod</link>
description: New Duplicants come out here, but thank goodness, they never go back in.
effect:
An exceptionally advanced bioprinter of unknown origin.

It periodically produces new Duplicants or care packages containing resources.

name: <link="HEATCOMPRESSOR">Liquid Heatquilizer</link>
description: "Room temperature" is relative, really.
effect: Heats or cools <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> to match ambient <link="HEAT">Air Temperature</link>.

name: <link="HIGHENERGYPARTICLEREDIRECTOR">Radbolt Reflector</link>
description: We were all out of mirrors.
effect: Receives and redirects Radbolts from <link="HIGHENERGYPARTICLESPAWNER">Radbolt Generators</link>.

name: <link="HIGHENERGYPARTICLESPAWNER">Radbolt Generator</link>
description: Radbolts are necessary for producing Materials Science research.
effect:
Attracts nearby <link="RADIATION">Radiation</link> to generate Radbolts.

Emits generated Radbolts in the direction of your choosing when the set Radbolt threshold is reached.

Radbolts collected will gradually decay while this building is disabled.

name: <link="HIJACKEDHEADQUARTERS">Printerceptor</link>
description: The access code required to reboot it for testing is located somewhere on this world.
effect: An unsanctioned bioprinter that runs on power siphoned from the <link="HEADQUARTERS">Printing Pod</link>.

name: <link="HOTTUB">Hot Tub</link>
description: Relaxes Duplicants with massaging jets of heated liquid.
effect:
Requires <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Pipes</link> to and from tub and <link="POWER">Power</link> to run the jets.

Water must be a comfortable temperature and will cool rapidly.

Increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link> and leaves them feeling deliciously warm.

name: <link="HYDROGENENGINECLUSTER">Hydrogen Engine</link>
description: Hydrogen engines can propel rockets further than steam or petroleum engines.
effect:
Burns <link="LIQUIDHYDROGEN">Liquid Hydrogen</link> to propel rockets for long-range space exploration.

Hydrogen Engines have the same generous height restrictions as <link="KEROSENEENGINE">Petroleum Engines</link> but are slightly faster.

Engine must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>, and requires an oxidizer tank.

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

name: <link="HYDROGENGENERATOR">Hydrogen Generator</link>
description: Hydrogen generators are extremely efficient, emitting next to no waste.
effect: Converts <link="HYDROGEN">Hydrogen Gas</link> into electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.

name: <link="HYDROPONICFARM">Hydroponic Farm</link>
description: Hydroponic farms reduce Duplicant traffic by automating irrigating crops.
effect:
Grows one <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> from a <link="PLANTS">Seed</link>.

Can be used as floor tile and rotated before construction.

Must be irrigated through <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Liquid Piping</link>.

name: <link="ICECOOLEDFAN">Ice-E Fan</link>
description: A Duplicant can work an Ice-E fan to temporarily cool small areas as needed.
effect: Uses <link="ICEORE">Ice</link> to dissipate a small amount of the <link="HEAT">Heat</link>.

name: <link="ICEKETTLE">Ice Liquefier</link>
description: The water never gets hot enough to burn the tongue.
effect: Consumes <link="WOOD">Wood</link> to melt <link="ICE">Ice</link> into <link="WATER">Water</link>, which can be bottled for transport.

name: <link="ICEMACHINE">Ice Maker</link>
description: Ice makers can be used as a small renewable source of ice and snow.
effect: Converts <link="WATER">Water</link> into <link="ICE">Ice</link> or <link="SNOW">Snow</link>.

name: <link="ICESCULPTURE">Ice Block</link>
description: Prone to melting.
effect:
Majorly increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

name: <link="INSULATEDGASCONDUIT">Insulated Gas Pipe</link>
description: Pipe insulation prevents gas contents from significantly changing temperature in transit.
effect:
Carries <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> with minimal change in <link="HEAT">Temperature</link>.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: <link="INSULATEDLIQUIDCONDUIT">Insulated Liquid Pipe</link>
description: Pipe insulation prevents liquid contents from significantly changing temperature in transit.
effect:
Carries <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> with minimal change in <link="HEAT">Temperature</link>.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: <link="INSULATIONTILE">Insulated Tile</link>
description: The low thermal conductivity of insulated tiles slows any heat passing through them.
effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Reduces <link="HEAT">Heat</link> transfer between walls, retaining ambient heat in an area.

name: <link="ITEMPEDESTAL">Pedestal</link>
description: Perception can be drastically changed by a bit of thoughtful presentation.
effect:
Displays a single object, doubling its <link="DECOR">Decor</link> value.

Objects with negative Decor will gain some positive Decor when displayed.

name: <link="JETSUITLOCKER">Jet Suit Dock</link>
description: Jet suit docks can refill jet suits with air and fuel, or empty them of waste.
effect:
Stores <link="JETSUIT">Jet Suits</link> and refuels them with <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link> and <link="COMBUSTIBLELIQUID">Combustible Liquid</link>.

Empties suits of <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link>.

Build next to a <link="JETSUITMARKER">Jet Suit Checkpoint</link> to make Duplicants change into suits when passing by.

name: <link="JETSUITMARKER">Jet Suit Checkpoint</link>
description: A checkpoint must have a correlating dock built on the opposite side its arrow faces.
effect:
Marks a threshold where Duplicants must change into or out of <link="JETSUIT">Jet Suits</link>.

Must be built next to a <link="JETSUITLOCKER">Jet Suit Dock</link>.

Can be rotated before construction.

name: <link="JUICER">Juicer</link>
description: Fruity juice can really brighten a Duplicant's breaktime
effect:
Provides refreshment for Duplicants on their breaks.

Drinking juice increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

name: <link="KEROSENEENGINECLUSTER">Petroleum Engine</link>
description: More powerful rocket engines can propel heavier burdens.
effect:
Burns <link="PETROLEUM">Petroleum</link> to propel rockets for mid-range space exploration.

Petroleum Engines have generous height restrictions, ideal for hauling many modules.

Engine must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>, and requires an oxidizer tank. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

name: <link="KEROSENEENGINECLUSTERSMALL">Small Petroleum Engine</link>
description: Rockets can be used to send Duplicants into space and retrieve rare resources.
effect:
Burns <link="PETROLEUM">Petroleum</link> to propel rockets for mid-range space exploration.

Small Petroleum Engines possess the same speed as a <link="KEROSENEENGINE">Petroleum Engines</link> but have smaller height restrictions.

Engine must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>, and requires an oxidizer tank.

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

name: <link="KILN">Kiln</link>
description: It gets quite hot.
effect:
Fires <link="CLAY">Clay</link> to produce <link="CERAMIC">Ceramic</link>, and <link="CARBON">Coal</link> or <link="WOOD">Wood</link> to produce <link="REFINEDCARBON">Refined Carbon</link>.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: <link="LADDERBED">Ladder Bed</link>
description: Duplicant's sleep will be interrupted if another Duplicant uses the ladder.
effect:
Provides a sleeping area for one Duplicant and also functions as a ladder.

Duplicants will automatically sleep in their assigned beds at night.

name: <link="LADDER">Ladder</link>
description: (That means they climb it.)
effect: Enables vertical mobility for Duplicants.

name: <link="LADDERFAST">Plastic Ladder</link>
description: Plastic ladders are mildly antiseptic and can help limit the spread of germs in a colony.
effect: Increases Duplicant climbing speed.

name: <link="LANDINGBEACON">Targeting Beacon</link>
description: Microtarget where your <link="RAILGUNPAYLOAD">Interplanetary Payload</link> lands on a Planetoid surface.
effect:
Guides <link="RAILGUNPAYLOAD">Interplanetary Payloads</link> and <link="ORBITALCARGOMODULE">Orbital Cargo Modules</link> to land nearby.

<link="RAILGUNPAYLOAD">Interplanetary Payloads</link> must be launched from a <link="RAILGUN">Interplanetary Launcher</link>.

name: <link="LARGEBACKWALLFARM">Wall Planter</link>
description: Vertical farming makes oversized organisms more accessible in limited spaces.
effect:
Grows one extra-large aquatic <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> from a <link="PLANTS">Seed</link>.

It also doubles as a wall tile.

name: <link="LARGEELECTROBANKDISCHARGER">Large Discharger</link>
description: It's basically its own power grid.
effect: Efficiently converts stored energy from <link="ELECTROBANK">Power Banks</link> into power for connected buildings.

name: <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>
description: A platform from which rockets can be launched and on which they can land.
effect:
Precursor to construction of all other Rocket modules.

Allows Rockets to launch from or land on the host Planetoid.

Automatically links up to <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTSOLID">Rocket Port</link><link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTSOLID">s</link> built to either side of the platform.

name: <link="LEADSUITLOCKER">Lead Suit Dock</link>
description: Lead suit docks can refill lead suits with air and empty them of waste.
effect:
Stores <link="LEADSUIT">Lead Suits</link> and refuels them with <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link>.

Empties suits of <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link>.

Build next to a <link="LEADSUITMARKER">Lead Suit Checkpoint</link> to make Duplicants change into suits when passing by.

name: <link="LEADSUITMARKER">Lead Suit Checkpoint</link>
description: A checkpoint must have a correlating dock built on the opposite side its arrow faces.
effect:
Marks a threshold where Duplicants must change into or out of <link="LEADSUIT">Lead Suits</link>.

Must be built next to a <link="LEADSUITLOCKER">Lead Suit Dock</link>

Can be rotated before construction.

name: <link="LIQUIDBOTTLER">Bottle Filler</link>
description: Bottle fillers allow Duplicants to manually deliver liquids from place to place.
effect: Automatically stores piped <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> into bottles for manual transport.

name: <link="LIQUIDCARGOBAYCLUSTER">Large Liquid Cargo Tank</link>
description: Holds more than a regular cargo tank.
effect:
Allows Duplicants to store most of the <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> resources found during space missions.

Stored resources become available to the colony upon the rocket's return.

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

name: <link="LIQUIDCARGOBAYSMALL">Liquid Cargo Tank</link>
description: Duplicants will fill cargo tanks with whatever resources they find during space missions.
effect:
Allows Duplicants to store some of the <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> resources found during space missions.

Stored resources become available to the colony upon the rocket's return. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

name: <link="LIQUIDCONDITIONER">Thermo Aquatuner</link>
description: A thermo aquatuner cools liquid and outputs the heat elsewhere.
effect: Cools the <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> piped through it, but outputs <link="HEAT">Heat</link> in its immediate vicinity.

name: <link="LIQUIDCONDUITBRIDGE">Liquid Bridge</link>
description: Separate pipe systems help prevent building damage caused by mingled pipe contents.
effect:
Runs one <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Liquid Pipe</link> section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: <link="LIQUIDCONDUIT">Liquid Pipe</link>
description: Liquid pipes are used to connect the inputs and outputs of plumbed buildings.
effect:
Carries <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> between <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Outputs</link> and <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Intakes</link>.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: <link="LIQUIDCONDUITOVERFLOW">Liquid Overflow Valve</link>
description: Overflow valves can be used to prioritize which buildings should receive precious resources first.
effect: Fills a secondary<link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> output only when its primary output is blocked.

name: <link="LIQUIDCONDUITPREFERENTIALFLOW">Priority Liquid Flow</link>
description: Priority flows ensure important buildings are filled first when on a system with other buildings.
effect: Diverts <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> to a secondary input when its primary input overflows.

name: <link="LIQUIDCONDUITRADIANT">Radiant Liquid Pipe</link>
description: Radiant pipes pumping cold liquid can be run through hot areas to help cool them down.
effect:
Carries <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>, allowing extreme <link="HEAT">Temperature</link> exchange with the surrounding environment.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: <link="LIQUIDCOOLEDFAN">Hydrofan</link>
description: A Duplicant can work a hydrofan to temporarily cool small areas as needed.
effect: Dissipates a small amount of the <link="HEAT">Heat</link>.

name: <link="LIQUIDFILTER">Liquid Filter</link>
description: All liquids are sent into the building's output pipe, except the liquid chosen for filtering.
effect:
Sieves one <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> out of a mix, sending it into a dedicated <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Filtered Output Pipe</link>.

Can only filter one liquid type at a time.

name: <link="LIQUIDFUELTANKCLUSTER">Large Liquid Fuel Tank</link>
description: Storing additional fuel increases the distance a rocket can travel before returning.
effect:
Stores the <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> fuel piped into it to supply rocket engines.

The stored fuel type is determined by the rocket engine it is built upon. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

name: <link="LIQUIDHEATER">Liquid Tepidizer</link>
description: Tepidizers heat liquid, which can kill waterborne germs.
effect:
Warms large bodies of <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>.

Must be fully submerged.

name: <link="LIQUIDLIMITVALVE">Liquid Meter Valve</link>
description: Meter Valves let an exact amount of liquid pass through before shutting off.
effect: Connects to an <link="LOGIC">Automation</link> grid to automatically turn <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> flow off when the specified amount has passed through it.

name: <link="LIQUIDLOGICVALVE">Liquid Shutoff</link>
description: Automated piping saves power and time by removing the need for Duplicant input.
effect: Connects to an <link="LOGIC">Automation</link> grid to automatically turn <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> flow on or off.

name: <link="LIQUIDMINIPUMP">Mini Liquid Pump</link>
description: Mini pumps are useful for moving small quantities of liquid with minimum power.
effect:
Draws in a small amount of <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> and runs it through <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Pipes</link>.

Must be submerged in <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>.

name: <link="LIQUIDPUMP">Liquid Pump</link>
description: Piping a pump's output to a building's intake will send liquid to that building.
effect:
Draws in <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> and runs it through <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Pipes</link>.

Must be submerged in <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>.

name: <link="LIQUIDPUMPINGSTATION">Pitcher Pump</link>
description: Pitcher pumps allow Duplicants to bottle and deliver liquids from place to place.
effect:
Manually pumps <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> into bottles for transport.

Duplicants can only carry liquids that are bottled.

name: <link="LIQUIDRESERVOIR">Liquid Reservoir</link>
description: Reservoirs cannot receive manually delivered resources.
effect: Stores any <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> resources piped into it.

name: <link="LIQUIDVALVE">Liquid Valve</link>
description: Valves control the amount of liquid that moves through pipes, preventing waste.
effect: Controls the <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> volume permitted through <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Pipes</link>.

name: <link="LIQUIDVENT">Liquid Vent</link>
description: Vents are an exit point for liquids from plumbing systems.
effect: Releases <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> from <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Liquid Pipes</link>.

name: <link="LOGICALARM">Automated Notifier</link>
description: Sends a notification when it receives a Green Signal.
effect:
Attach to sensors to send a notification when certain conditions are met.

Notifications can be customized.

name: <link="LOGICCLUSTERLOCATIONSENSOR">Starmap Location Sensor</link>
description: Starmap Location sensors can signal when a spacecraft is at a certain location
effect: Send Green Signals at the chosen Starmap locations and Red Signals everywhere else.

name: <link="LOGICCOUNTER">Signal Counter</link>
description: For numbers higher than ten connect multiple counters together.
effect: Counts how many times a Green Signal has been received up to a chosen number. When the chosen number is reached it sends a Green Signal until it receives another Green Signal, when it resets automatically and begins counting again.

name: <link="LOGICCRITTERCOUNTSENSOR">Critter Sensor</link>
description: Detecting critter populations can help adjust their automated feeding and care regimens.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on the number of eggs and critters in a room.

name: <link="LOGICDISEASESENSOR">Germ Sensor</link>
description: Detecting germ populations can help block off or clean up dangerous areas.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on quantity of surrounding Germs.

name: <link="LOGICDUPLICANTSENSOR">Duplicant Motion Sensor</link>
description: Motion sensors save power by only enabling buildings when Duplicants are nearby.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on whether a Duplicant is in the sensor's range.

name: <link="LOGICELEMENTSENSORGAS">Gas Element Sensor</link>
description: These sensors can detect the presence of a specific gas and alter systems accordingly.
effect: Sends a Green Signal when the selected Gas is detected on this sensor's tile. Sends a Red Signal when the selected Gas is not present.

name: <link="LOGICELEMENTSENSORLIQUID">Liquid Element Sensor</link>
description: These sensors can detect the presence of a specific liquid and alter systems accordingly.
effect: Sends a Green Signal when the selected Liquid is detected on this sensor's tile. Sends a Red Signal when the selected Liquid is not present.

name: <link="LOGICGATEAND">AND Gate</link>
description: This gate outputs a Green Signal when both its inputs are receiving Green Signals at the same time.
effect: Outputs a Green Signal when both Input A AND Input B are receiving Green. Outputs a Red Signal when even one Input is receiving Red.

name: <link="LOGICGATEOR">OR Gate</link>
description: This gate outputs a Green Signal if receiving one or more Green Signals.
effect: Outputs a Green Signal if at least one of Input A OR Input B is receiving Green. Outputs a Red Signal when neither Input A or Input B are receiving Green.

name: <link="LOGICGATEXOR">XOR Gate</link>
description: This gate outputs a Green Signal if exactly one of its Inputs is receiving a Green Signal.
effect: Outputs a Green Signal if exactly one of its Inputs is receiving Green. Outputs a Red Signal if both or neither Inputs are receiving a Green Signal.

name: <link="LOGICGATENOT">NOT Gate</link>
description: This gate reverses automation signals, turning a Green Signal into a Red Signal and vice versa.
effect: Outputs a Green Signal if the Input is receiving a Red Signal. Outputs a Red Signal when its Input is receiving a Green Signal.

name: <link="LOGICGATEBUFFER">BUFFER Gate</link>
description: This gate continues outputting a Green Signal for a short time after the gate stops receiving a Green Signal.
effect: Outputs a Green Signal if the Input is receiving a Green Signal. Continues sending a Green Signal for an amount of buffer time after the Input receives a Red Signal.

name: <link="LOGICGATEFILTER">FILTER Gate</link>
description: This gate only lets a Green Signal through if its Input has received a Green Signal that lasted longer than the selected filter time.
effect: Only lets a Green Signal through if the Input has received a Green Signal for longer than the selected filter time. Will continue outputting a Red Signal if the Green Signal did not last long enough.

name: <link="LOGICGATEMULTIPLEXER">Signal Selector</link>
description: Signal Selectors can be used to select which automation signal is relevant to pass through to a given circuit
effect: Select which one of four Input signals should be sent out the Output, using Control Inputs. Send a Green Signal or a Red Signal to the two Control Inputs to determine which Input is selected.

name: <link="LOGICGATEDEMULTIPLEXER">Signal Distributor</link>
description: Signal Distributors can be used to choose which circuit should receive a given automation signal.
effect: Route a single Input signal out one of four possible Outputs, based on the selection made by the Control Inputs. Send a Green Signal or a Red Signal to the two Control Inputs to determine which Output is selected.

name: <link="LOGICHEPSENSOR">Radbolt Sensor</link>
description: Radbolt sensors can send a signal when a Radbolt passes over them.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when Radbolts detected enters the chosen range.

name: <link="LOGICHAMMER">Hammer</link>
description: The hammer makes neat sounds when it strikes buildings.
effect: In its default orientation, the hammer strikes the building to the left when it receives a Green Signal. Each building has a unique sound when struck by the hammer. The hammer does no damage when it strikes.

name: <link="LOGICINTERASTEROIDRECEIVER">Automation Receiver</link>
description: Receives automation signals from space.
effect: Receives a Green Signal or a Red Signal from an Automation Broadcaster over vast distances in space. Both the Automation Receiver and the Automation Broadcaster must be exposed to space to function.

name: <link="LOGICINTERASTEROIDSENDER">Automation Broadcaster</link>
description: Sends automation signals into space.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal to an Automation Receiver over vast distances in space. Both the Automation Broadcaster and the Automation Receiver must be exposed to space to function.

name: <link="LOGICLIGHTSENSOR">Light Sensor</link>
description: Light sensors can tell surface bunker doors above solar panels to open or close based on solar light levels.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when ambient Brightness enters the chosen range.

name: <link="LOGICMEMORY">Memory Toggle</link>
description: A Memory stores a Green Signal received in the Set Port (S) until the Reset Port (R) receives a Green Signal.
effect: Contains an internal Memory, and will output whatever signal is stored in that Memory. Signals sent to the Inputs only affect the Memory, and do not pass through to the Output. Sending a Green Signal to the Set Port (S) will set the memory to Green. Sending a Green Signal to the Reset Port (R) will reset the memory back to Red.

name: <link="LOGICPOWERRELAY">Power Shutoff</link>
description: Automated systems save power and time by removing the need for Duplicant input.
effect:
Connects to an <link="LOGIC">Automation</link> grid to automatically turn <link="POWER">Power</link> on or off.

Does not affect circuitry preceding the switch.

name: <link="LOGICPRESSURESENSORGAS">Atmo Sensor</link>
description: Atmo sensors can be used to prevent excess oxygen production and overpressurization.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when Gas pressure enters the chosen range.

name: <link="LOGICPRESSURESENSORLIQUID">Hydro Sensor</link>
description: A hydro sensor can tell a pump to refill its basin as soon as it contains too little liquid.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when Liquid pressure enters the chosen range. Must be submerged in Liquid.

name: <link="LOGICRADIATIONSENSOR">Radiation Sensor</link>
description: Radiation sensors can disable buildings when they detect dangerous levels of radiation.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when ambient Radiation enters the chosen range.

name: <link="LOGICRIBBONBRIDGE">Automation Ribbon Bridge</link>
description: Wire bridges allow multiple automation grids to exist in a small area without connecting.
effect:
Runs one <link="LOGICRIBBON">Automation Ribbon</link> section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: <link="LOGICRIBBON">Automation Ribbon</link>
description: Logic ribbons use significantly less space to carry multiple automation signals.
effect:
A 4-Bit <link="LOGICWIRE">Automation Wire</link> which can carry up to four automation signals.

Use a <link="LOGICRIBBONWRITER">Ribbon Writer</link> to output to multiple Bits, and a <link="LOGICRIBBONREADER">Ribbon Reader</link> to input from multiple Bits.

name: <link="LOGICRIBBONREADER">Ribbon Reader</link>
description: Inputs the signal from a single Bit in an <link="LOGICRIBBON">Automation Ribbon</link> into an <link="LOGICWIRE">Automation Wire</link>.
effect: Reads a Green Signal or a Red Signal from the specified Bit of an Automation Ribbon onto an Automation Wire.

name: <link="LOGICRIBBONWRITER">Ribbon Writer</link>
description: Translates the signal from an <link="LOGICWIRE">Automation Wire</link> to a single Bit in an <link="LOGICRIBBON">Automation Ribbon</link>
effect: Writes a Green Signal or a Red Signal to the specified Bit of an Automation Ribbon Automation Ribbon must be used as the output wire to avoid overloading.

name: <link="LOGICSWITCH">Signal Switch</link>
description: Signal switches don't turn grids on and off like power switches, but add an extra signal.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal on an Automation grid.

name: <link="LOGICTEMPERATURESENSOR">Thermo Sensor</link>
description: Thermo sensors can disable buildings when they approach dangerous temperatures.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when ambient Temperature enters the chosen range.

name: <link="LOGICTIMEOFDAYSENSOR">Cycle Sensor</link>
description: Cycle sensors ensure systems always turn on at the same time, day or night, every cycle.
effect: Sets an automatic Green Signal and Red Signal schedule within one day-night cycle.

name: <link="LOGICTIMERSENSOR">Timer Sensor</link>
description: Timer sensors create automation schedules for very short or very long periods of time.
effect: Creates a timer to send Green Signals and Red Signals for specific amounts of time.

name: <link="LOGICWATTAGESENSOR">Wattage Sensor</link>
description: Wattage sensors can send a signal when a building has switched on or off.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when Wattage consumed enters the chosen range.

name: <link="LOGICWIREBRIDGE">Automation Wire Bridge</link>
description: Wire bridges allow multiple automation grids to exist in a small area without connecting.
effect:
Runs one <link="LOGICWIRE">Automation Wire</link> section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: <link="LOGICWIRE">Automation Wire</link>
description: Automation wire is used to connect building ports to automation gates.
effect:
Connects buildings to <link="LOGIC">Sensors</link>.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: <link="STORYTRAITLONELYMINION">Gravitas Shipping Container</link>
description: Its occupant has been alone for so long, he's forgotten what friendship feels like.
effect:
A large transport unit from the facility's sub-sub-basement.

It has been modified into a crude yet functional temporary shelter.

name: Mailbox
description: There's nothing quite like receiving homemade gifts in the mail.
effect: Displays a single edible object.

name: <link="LUXURYBED">Comfy Bed</link>
description: Duplicants prefer comfy beds to cots and wake up more rested after sleeping in them.
effect:
Provides a sleeping area for one Duplicant and restores additional stamina.

Duplicants will automatically sleep in their assigned beds at night.

name: <link="MACHINESHOP">Mechanics Station</link>
description: Duplicants will only improve the efficiency of buildings in the same room as this station.
effect:
Allows the assigned <link="MACHINETECHNICIAN">Engineer</link> to improve building production efficiency.

This building is a necessary component of the Machine Shop room.

name: <link="MANUALGENERATOR">Manual Generator</link>
description: Watching Duplicants run on it is adorable... the electrical power is just an added bonus.
effect: Converts manual labor into electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.

name: <link="MANUALHIGHENERGYPARTICLESPAWNER">Manual Radbolt Generator</link>
description: Radbolts are necessary for producing Materials Science research.
effect:
Refines radioactive ores to generate Radbolts.

Emits generated Radbolts in the direction of your choosing.

name: <link="MANUALPRESSUREDOOR">Manual Airlock</link>
description: Airlocks can quarter off dangerous areas and prevent gases from seeping into the colony.
effect:
Blocks <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> and <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> flow, maintaining pressure between areas.

Wild <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> cannot pass through doors.

name: <link="MARBLESCULPTURE">Marble Block</link>
description: Duplicants who have learned art skills can produce more decorative sculptures.
effect:
Majorly increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

name: <link="MASSAGETABLE">Massage Table</link>
description: Massage tables quickly reduce extreme stress, at the cost of power production.
effect:
Rapidly reduces <link="STRESS">Stress</link> for the Duplicant user.

Duplicants will automatically seek a massage table when <link="STRESS">Stress</link> exceeds breaktime range.

name: <link="MASSIVEHEATSINK">Anti Entropy Thermo-Nullifier</link>
effect:
A self-sustaining machine powered by what appears to be refined <link="UNOBTANIUM">Neutronium</link>.

Absorbs and neutralizes <link="HEAT">Heat</link> energy when provided with piped <link="HYDROGEN">Hydrogen Gas</link>.

name: <link="MECHANICALSURFBOARD">Mechanical Surfboard</link>
description: Mechanical waves make for radical relaxation time.
effect:
Increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Some <link="WATER">Water</link> gets splashed on the floor during use.

name: <link="MEDICALCOT">Triage Cot</link>
description: Duplicants use triage cots to recover from physical injuries and receive aid from peers.
effect:
Accelerates <link="HEALTH">Health</link> restoration and the healing of physical injuries.

Revives incapacitated Duplicants.

name: <link="MEGABRAINTANK">Somnium Synthesizer</link>
effect:
An organic multi-cortex repository and processing system fuelled by <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link>.

Analyzes <link="DREAMJOURNAL">Dream Journals</link> produced by Duplicants wearing <link="SLEEPCLINICPAJAMAS">Pajamas</link>.

Provides a sustainable boost to Duplicant skills and abilities throughout the colony.

name: <link="MERCURYCEILINGLIGHT">Mercury Ceiling Light</link>
description: Mercury ceiling lights take a while to reach full brightness, but once they do...zowie!
effect:
Uses <link="MERCURY">Mercury</link> and <link="POWER">Power</link> to produce <link="LIGHT">Light</link>.

Light reduces Duplicant stress and is required to grow certain plants.

name: <link="MESHTILE">Mesh Tile</link>
description: Mesh tile can be used to make Duplicant pathways in areas where liquid flows.
effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Does not obstruct <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> or <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> flow.

name: <link="METALREFINERY">Metal Refinery</link>
description: Refined metals are necessary to build advanced electronics and technologies.
effect:
Produces <link="REFINEDMETAL">Refined Metals</link> from raw <link="METAL">Metal Ore</link>.

Significantly <link="HEAT">Heats</link> and outputs the <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> piped into it.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: <link="METALSCULPTURE">Metal Block</link>
description: Duplicants who have learned art skills can produce more decorative sculptures.
effect:
Majorly increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

name: <link="METALTILE">Metal Tile</link>
description: Heat travels much more quickly through metal tile than other types of flooring.
effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Significantly increases Duplicant runspeed.

name: <link="METHANEGENERATOR">Natural Gas Generator</link>
description: Natural gas generators leak polluted water and are best built above a waste reservoir.
effect:
Converts <link="METHANE">Natural Gas</link> into electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.

Produces <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link> and <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link>.

name: <link="MICROBEMUSHER">Microbe Musher</link>
description: Musher recipes will keep Duplicants fed, but may impact health and morale over time.
effect:
Produces low quality <link="FOOD">Food</link> using common ingredients.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: <link="MILKFATSEPARATOR">Gleaner</link>
description: Duplicants can slather up with brackwax to increase their travel speed in transit tubes.
effect: Refines <link="MILK">Brackene</link> into <link="BRINE">Brine</link> and <link="MILKFAT">Brackwax</link>, and <link="FISHMILK">Ovolene</link> into <link="CAVIAR">Caviar</link> and <link="MUCUS">Mucin</link>.

name: <link="MILKFEEDER">Critter Fountain</link>
description: Providing beverages to critters makes them feel taken care of.
effect:
Dispenses <link="MILK">Brackene</link> or <link="INK">Squid Ink</link> to a wide variety of <link="CREATURES">Critters</link>.

Accessing the fountain significantly improves <link="CREATURES">Critters</link>' moods.

name: <link="MILKPRESS">Plant Pulverizer</link>
description: For Duplicants who are too squeamish to milk critters.
effect:
Crushes organic materials to extract liquids such as <link="MILK">Brackene</link> or <link="PHYTOOIL">Phyto Oil</link>.

<link="MILK">Brackene</link> can be used to refill the <link="MILKFEEDER">Critter Fountain</link>.

name: <link="MILKINGSTATION">Milking Station</link>
description: Brackene can be used at the Critter Fountain to improve critters' moods.
effect: Allows Duplicants with the <link="RANCHING2">Critter Ranching II</link> skill to milk <link="MOOSPECIES">Moos</link> for  <link="MILK">Brackene</link> or  <link="REFINEDLIPID">Biodiesel</link>.

name: <link="MINERALDEOXIDIZER">Oxygen Diffuser</link>
description: Oxygen diffusers are inefficient, but output enough oxygen to keep a colony breathing.
effect:
Converts large amounts of <link="ALGAE">Algae</link> into <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link>.

Becomes idle when the area reaches maximum pressure capacity.

name: <link="MINIFRIDGE">Mini Fridge</link>
description: It's very small.
effect: Stores <link="FOOD">Food</link> at an ideal <link="HEAT">Temperature</link> to prevent spoilage.

name: <link="MISSILELAUNCHER">Meteor Blaster</link>
description: Some meteors drop harvestable resources when they're blown to smithereens.
effect:
Fires explosive projectiles at incoming space objects to defend the colony from impact-related damage.

Projectiles must be crafted at a <link="MISSILEFABRICATOR">Blastshot Maker</link>.

Range: 16 tiles horizontally, 32 tiles vertically.

name: <link="MISSILEFABRICATOR">Blastshot Maker</link>
description: Blastshot shells are an effective defense against incoming meteor showers.
effect:
Produces <link="MISSILELAUNCHER">Blastshot</link> from <link="REFINEDMETAL">Refined Metals</link> combined with <link="PETROLEUM">Petroleum</link>.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: <link="MISSIONCONTROLCLUSTER">Mission Control Station</link>
description: Like a backseat driver who actually does know better.
effect:
Provides guidance data to rocket pilots within range, to improve rocket speed.

Must be operated by a Duplicant with the <link="ASTRONOMY">Astronomy</link> skill.

Requires a clear line of sight to space in order to function.

name: <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTBRIDGE">Rocket Port Extension</link>
description: Allows rocket platforms to be built farther apart.
effect: Automatically links when built to the side of a <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link> or any <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTSOLID">Rocket Port</link>.

name: <link="MODULARLAUNCHPADPORTGAS">Gas Rocket Port Loader</link>
description: Rockets must be landed to load or unload resources.
effect:
Loads <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gases</link> to the storage of a linked rocket.
